title: TrueNorth question
description: One exam-style question, `content/questions/<subject>/<id>.json`. Prompt, options and explanation carry their EN and FR text inline rather than as locale keys (ADR-0010): the verifier reads the claim, its source, its evidence and both languages in one file, and a quarantined question takes its text out of the build with it.

options.description: Exactly four options - one correct, three distractors (CLAUDE.md, Content rules). A fixed-length tuple, not a bounded list, so the port can mirror it as one.

correctIndex.description: Index into options. Answer order is fixed by the author; shuffling is a presentation decision the domain makes from a seed.

explanation.description: Why the answer is right, in plain language. Shown after answering, in Study mode as well as in a quest.
